name: Document Intelligence
description: Reads the documents a business runs on, from company filings and contracts to cap tables and question papers, and turns them into checked, structured output.

name: Visual Intelligence
description: Reads images and handwriting: which animal walked into a farm plot at night, and what a student wrote on a handwritten exam sheet.

name: Call & Voice Analytics
description: Turns call recordings into evidence: every call transcribed and scored against its script, with the line behind each score.

name: AI Assistants
description: Assistants that answer your people from your own material, and hand the question to a person when they should.

name: Data Engineering & Reporting
description: Pipelines and reports on your own data: self-serve reports with personal data masked until approval, and Tally entries classified from your own books.
